candidates.label: Softer lip transition and less exposed teeth
candidates.review: The lip border is less drawn-on and the shorter tooth row is gentler, but the eyes and nasal mound remain generic. No meaningful overall likeness gain yet.

stats.designLabel: Softer lip transition and less exposed teeth

candidates.label: Flatter cheek plane and narrower nasal mound
candidates.review: The cheek plane is less spherical and the narrower nasal mound improves the three-quarter view. The broad forehead and open white eye shapes still dominate.

stats.designLabel: Flatter cheek plane and narrower nasal mound

candidates.label: Closer-set eyes and fuller lower eyelid
candidates.review: Closer eye spacing and reduced scleral brightness give a calmer expression. The larger lower-lid patch is coherent, but the original nasal silhouette is still too blunt.

stats.designLabel: Closer-set eyes and fuller lower eyelid

candidates.label: Integrated anatomy, lips and eye proportions
candidates.review: The combined eye, cheek and lip adjustments are the most balanced of this set in both views. Select as the next design baseline; head length and neck exposure still need correction.

stats.designLabel: Integrated anatomy, lips and eye proportions

candidates.label: Shorter, fuller head proportions
candidates.review: The shorter head helps the body ratio, but the combined width and chin expansion make the face too broad and flat. Do not select this combination.

candidates.label: Reduced neck exposure and raised collar fit
candidates.review: Reduced neck exposure and the higher collar improve the full figure. The stronger head roll is plausible, although the original long facial proportions remain.

stats.designLabel: Reduced neck exposure and raised collar fit

candidates.label: Softer chin and slimmer nasal bridge
candidates.review: The nasal bridge is less blunt and the chin reads softer. The face is more balanced, but the neck still looks stretched above the collar.

stats.designLabel: Softer chin and slimmer nasal bridge

candidates.label: Integrated skull, neck and nose correction
candidates.review: The moderate skull shortening, neck reduction and nasal change work best together. The face remains generic, but the full-body proportion is less doll-like. Select this integrated version.

stats.designLabel: Integrated skull, neck and nose correction

candidates.label: Gentler, narrower smile
candidates.review: The narrower smile is gentler, but it loses some of the reference's cheerful openness. Profile review reveals the chin remains too recessed relative to the mouth and nose.

candidates.label: Recessed oral cavity and rounded lips
candidates.review: The oral recess has genuine depth, but the larger lip projection and dark opening make the mouth heavier. The profile still needs a stronger chin rather than more lip volume.

stats.designLabel: Recessed oral cavity and rounded lips

candidates.label: Lifted smile corners and softened nasal crease
candidates.review: Raised corners make the expression brighter, although the thinner lip transition looks slightly stretched at the ends. The profile limitation remains.

stats.designLabel: Lifted smile corners and softened nasal crease

candidates.label: Moderate cavity depth and balanced smile
candidates.review: The moderate cavity and narrower smile are the most natural combination here. Retain the restrained lip volume; next correct the recessed chin and nasal/profile balance.

stats.designLabel: Moderate cavity depth and balanced smile

candidates.label: Moderate chin projection
candidates.review: Moderate chin projection improves the side silhouette, but the lower face still tapers backward more than desired. It is a conservative improvement, not a complete correction.

candidates.label: Stronger chin and reduced nasal tip
candidates.review: The strongest chin setting creates a conspicuous lower-face bulge in three-quarter view. Reject the larger projection despite the less recessed profile.

stats.designLabel: Stronger chin and reduced nasal tip

candidates.label: Forward chin with softer brow ridge
candidates.review: The softer brow ridge and nasal bridge are helpful, but the broad cheek flattening and chin together make the mouth-to-jaw transition too uniform.

stats.designLabel: Forward chin with softer brow ridge

candidates.label: Balanced lower-face and nasal contour
candidates.review: This is the best compromise: the chin supports the mouth without a large bulb, and the nose/profile balance is improved. The ear still looks like stacked simple primitives and is the next visible defect.
